form.title: Φόρμα
form.empty.heading: Η φόρμα αίτησής σας
form.empty.body: Επιλέξτε τις ερωτήσεις που απαντούν οι επιχειρήσεις όταν υποβάλλουν αίτηση χονδρικής.
form.list.proNote: Use separate forms for different audiences, for example retailers and distributors, each with its own suggested tier.
form.list.name: Name
form.list.addBody: The new form starts with the standard questions. You can change them after it's created.
form.list.nameRequired: Enter a name for the form.
form.settings.name: Form name
form.settings.nameHelp: Only you and your staff see this name.
form.settings.tierHelp: Pre-selected when you approve an application from this form. You can still choose another tier.
form.settings.noTiers: Create a tier first to suggest it here.
form.settings.defaultSet: This is now the default form
form.settings.deleteBody: {name} will be removed and page blocks that use it will show your default form instead. Applications already received from it are kept.
form.lang.label: Language
form.lang.help: Texts you leave empty use Tradepass's built-in translation for this language.
form.errors.heading: {count, plural, one {Fix # problem before saving} other {Fix # problems before saving}}
form.saved.syncLater: Saved. The storefront will update within an hour.
form.section.empty: No questions in this section. Drag a question here or add one below.
form.field.lockedHint: Every application needs this, so it can't be hidden.
form.field.label: Label
form.field.defaultHint: Leave empty to use the built-in text shown in grey.
form.field.consentHint: Edit the consent text in the Consent section below.
form.fieldName.referral: How did you hear about us?
form.options.heading: Answer options
form.options.empty: No options yet. Add at least one.
form.options.label: Option {n}
form.showIf.toggle: Only show this question for a certain answer
form.showIf.noSources: Add a dropdown or checkbox question above this one first.
form.add.heading: Add a question
form.add.body: Custom questions appear on the form and in each application.
form.delete.heading: Delete this question?
form.delete.body: {field} will be removed from the form when you save. Answers in applications you've already received are kept.
form.consent.heading: Consent
form.consent.privacyUrlHelp: Shown next to the consent checkbox. Use a full address or a store path such as /policies/privacy-policy.
form.success.heading: After submitting
form.success.messageHelp: Applicants also see that a confirmation email is on its way.
form.success.redirectHelp: Send applicants to another page after the thank-you message, for example /pages/thank-you.
form.spam.heading: Spam protection
form.spam.body: Tradepass already blocks most spam with hidden checks and rate limits. Add a simple question only if spam still gets through.
form.spam.question: Question
form.preview.heading: Preview
form.preview.note: The preview uses your unsaved changes. Your theme's fonts and colours apply on the storefront.
form.preview.unavailableBody: You can still edit and save the form. Open the page with the form block on your store to see it.
form.place.heading: Add the form to a page
form.place.step1: Create a page for applications, for example "Wholesale" at /pages/wholesale.
form.place.step2: In the theme editor, open that page's template and add the "Wholesale application form" block.
form.place.step3: Turn on the Tradepass app embed so the Apply button and price gating work.
form.error.invalid: Something in this form couldn't be read. Reload the page and try again.
form.error.lockedHidden: {field} is needed for every application, so it can't be hidden or conditional.
form.error.lockedMissing: {field} is missing from the form. Reload the page to restore it.
form.error.duplicateId: {field} appears twice. Delete one of them.
form.error.badCustomId: {field} has an invalid internal id. Delete it and add it again.
form.error.badType: {field} has a question type that isn't supported. Delete it and add it again.
form.error.labelRequired: Give {field} a label in at least one language, including every answer option.
form.error.tooLong: A text in {field} is too long. Shorten it.
form.error.optionsRequired: Add at least one answer option to {field}.
form.error.badOptionValue: An answer option in {field} is invalid. Remove it and add it again.
form.error.duplicateOption: {field} has the same answer option twice. Remove one.
form.error.tooManyOptions: {field} can have up to {max} answer options.
form.error.showIfMissing: {field} depends on a question that was deleted. Choose another or turn the condition off.
form.error.showIfNotChoice: {field} can only depend on a dropdown or checkbox question with options.
form.error.showIfBadValue: {field} depends on an answer that no longer exists. Choose another answer.
form.error.showIfHidden: {field} depends on a hidden question, so it would never show. Show that question or turn the condition off.
form.error.showIfOrder: {field} depends on a question further down. Move it below that question.
form.error.badUrl: Enter a web address starting with https:// or a store path starting with /.
form.error.spamIncomplete: Enter both a question and an answer, or turn the spam question off.
form.error.tooManyFields: A form can have up to {max} questions.
form.error.nameRequired: Enter a form name of up to 80 characters.
